losoph. cap. xxi. Macrobium lib. i. in Somnium Scipion. cap. xx, Diogenem Laer-

tum ajunt Solem, quantus apparet: pedalem tribuentes latitudinem. Anaxagoras
majorem censuit Peloponneso. Anaximander Solis corpus æquale fecit Terræ;
Orbem vero, in quo circumvehitur, septies vicies Terra maiorem; quod de ipso
Sole notat Eratosthenes. Secundum Ptolemæum Sol major est Terra centies sexa-
gies septies cum tribus octavis: cujus sententiam plerique sequuntur & varie stabi-
liunt Mathematici. Copernicus superioribus annis minorem deprehendit; ejusque
corpus Terram superare centies sexagies bis, octava minus. Posidonius, nihil au-

Several Greek and italic passages are uncertain, especially the Greek lines and the Latin verse of Lucan; the verse at line 30 and the marginal Greek are reconstructed from the scan. The lower word "sus" is a fragment continuing the last line and is marked as a foot fragment.
